WS03.boundary: game/auth runtime consumes WS45 account/character ownership; WS45 does not import or own WS03 product code

WS08.boundary: WS45 supplies online ownership snapshot and revoke/kick primitives only; full admin runtime authority remains external

postgres.migration_order: after WS07 database/migrations/0002_persistence_hardening.sql; never append to the WS07 numbered ledger

schema.expires_at: expires_at generated alias of lease_until epoch milliseconds

atomic_primitives.acquire: acquire -> INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
atomic_primitives.replace: replace -> version-conditional UPDATE; account takeover deletes displaced character leases in the same transaction
atomic_primitives.expiry_reclaim: reclaimExpired -> version + lease_until condition inside one transaction
rules: PRIMARY KEY (scope, lease_key) is the uniqueness boundary
updates/deletes are conditioned on the expected lease version
no application-side blind write after an unlocked SELECT
old owners cannot delete or renew a newer version
stale account reclaim and replace-old remove displaced character leases atomically

policy.heartbeat: active leases only; version CAS prevents displaced owners from renewing newer ownership
policy.stale_reclaim: lease_until <= service clock permits CAS reclaim with generation increment
policy.crash_recovery: no release call is required; TTL expiry followed by CAS reclaim is authoritative
policy.reconnect: grace state + grace_until + expected version; concurrent resume has one CAS winner

WS03.note: WS03/game code is not imported into WS45; production composition injects this service/store boundary.

real_postgres_cases: two independent stores forced to observe the same empty account state; exactly one reject-new winner
replace-old plus stale old-owner heartbeat/release cannot remove the new lease
concurrent character acquire with account ownership precondition
process crash without release -> TTL stale reclaim and orphan character cleanup
